sections.headline: Build the cold chain India needs. With us.
sections.subheadline:
Crystal is building India's most capable cold chain platform, and we're looking for people who want to build it with us.
If you're driven by complex problems, operational excellence, and the chance to work on infrastructure that genuinely matters, you're in the right place.

items.title: Real ownership
items.description: Crystal is a growing platform. The work you do here has direct impact: on the business, on our clients, and on India's cold chain.

items.title: Hard problems
items.description: Cold chain is one of the most complex operational sectors in the country. You'll be solving problems most people don't even know exist.

items.title: Growing fast
items.description: Crystal is expanding rapidly across India. There's room to grow your career as fast as the business grows.

items.title: Experienced team
items.description: Work alongside people who have spent their careers in cold chain, and learn from one of the most experienced teams in the sector.

sections.headline: Areas we hire for.
sections.body: We are always looking for specialists across the entire cold chain spectrum: from engineering to ground operations.

sections.headline: Open roles.
sections.body: We are always looking for exceptional talent to build India's cold chain platform.

roles.title: Reefer Engineer
roles.salary: ₹4 – ₹8 LPA (Based on experience and technical expertise)
roles.timing: 09:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Saturday
roles.company_overview: Crystal Logistics is India's trusted cold chain and warehousing partner, delivering reliable temperature-controlled logistics nationwide. We specialize in Reefer Container Leasing, Portable Cold Storage, Cold Storage Warehousing, and Temperature-Controlled Logistics Solutions. We foster a collaborative, innovation-driven work culture where talent is recognized, developed, and empowered to deliver operational excellence.
roles.role_summary:
We are looking for a technically skilled Reefer Engineer to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair reefer containers and refrigeration systems. The role is responsible for ensuring maximum equipment uptime, maintaining temperature performance, and providing prompt technical support to customers and internal teams.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in refrigeration systems, preventive maintenance, and fault diagnosis, with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
responsibilities: Install, commission, and service reefer containers and refrigeration units.
Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of refrigeration systems.
Diagnose and repair electrical, mechanical, and refrigeration faults.
Conduct gas charging, leak detection, pressure testing, and system calibration.
Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, control panels, and refrigeration circuits.
Maintain service reports, maintenance records, and technical documentation.
Coordinate with Operations, Service, and Customer Support teams for timely issue resolution.
Ensure compliance with safety standards and preventive maintenance schedules.
Provide technical support during installation, commissioning, and customer handover.
roles.experience: 2–6 years of experience in Reefer Containers, Cold Chain, HVAC, Refrigeration, or Industrial Cooling Systems. Experience with Carrier, Thermo King, Daikin, Star Cool, or Mitsubishi refrigeration systems is preferred. Hands-on experience in installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

roles.title: Purchase Head
roles.company_overview: Established in 1962, Crystal Cold Chain has over 60 years of experience in delivering reliable temperature-controlled storage and logistics solutions across India. We specialize in Portable Cold Storage Containers, Cold Storage Warehouses, and temperature-controlled transportation services, ensuring safe and efficient handling of temperature-sensitive goods. Our solutions support a wide range of industries, including FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Agriculture, Meat & Seafood, Chemicals, Quick Commerce, and other temperature-sensitive sectors. With a strong legacy of trust and operational excellence, Crystal Cold Chain continues to provide flexible and dependable cold chain solutions tailored to modern industry needs.
roles.role_summary: The Purchase Head will be responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies, managing the purchase team, negotiating with key vendors, controlling procurement costs, and ensuring timely availability of materials for projects and operations. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Cold Room and Refrigeration materials, project BOQs, technical specifications, vendor networks, and commercial negotiations.
responsibilities: 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning:
Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business and project requirements.
Plan procurement activities based on project schedules, BOQs, inventory levels, and operational requirements.
Ensure timely availability of materials without affecting project execution.
Establish standard procurement processes, approval mechanisms, and vendor evaluation systems.
Monitor procurement budgets and ensure purchases are within approved commercial limits.
2. Cold Room & Technical Procurement:
Coordinate offer rollouts, document collection, background verification, and onboarding activities.
Lead procurement for Cold Room, Cold Storage, Refrigeration, HVAC, and related projects.
Develop strong understanding of technical materials and project requirements.
Review BOQs, technical specifications, drawings and material requirements with Project and Engineering teams.
Ensure procurement meets approved quality and technical specifications.
3. Vendor Development & Management:
Identify, evaluate, approve, and develop reliable vendors and suppliers.
Build and maintain a strong vendor network for cold room, refrigeration, engineering and project materials.
Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, credit periods, delivery schedules, warranties and service conditions.
Conduct regular vendor performance reviews based on quality, cost, delivery and service.
Develop alternate vendors to reduce supply risks and dependency.
4. Cost Control & Commercial Negotiation
Lead negotiations for major purchases and strategic procurement contracts.
Analyse market prices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
Conduct comparative analysis of vendor quotations and commercial proposals.
Drive procurement cost optimisation without compromising quality or project requirements.
Monitor price fluctuations of key materials and develop appropriate procurement strategies.
5. Purchase Operations & Team Management
Lead and supervise the Purchase / Procurement team.
Allocate purchase requirements and monitor team performance.
Review and approve purchase orders as per company authority matrix.
Establish clear processes for quotation, comparison, approval, PO issuance, delivery tracking and invoice coordination.
Train and guide the procurement team on processes, negotiation, vendor management and compliance.
6. Project & Internal Coordination
Coordinate closely with Project, Engineering, Site, Stores, Operations, Finance and Accounts teams.
Ensure procurement plans are aligned with project execution schedules.
Resolve material shortages, delivery delays, quality concerns and supplier issues.
Support project teams with urgent and critical procurement requirements.
Ensure timely availability of materials at project sites and warehouses.
7. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination
Coordinate with Stores / Inventory teams to monitor stock levels and material requirements.
Review slow-moving, non-moving and excess inventory.
Ensure appropriate procurement planning based on existing inventory.
Support optimisation of working capital through effective purchasing and inventory planning.
Develop systems to improve material availability and reduce procurement lead times.
8. Compliance & Documentation
Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and approval procedures.
Maintain proper records of vendor quotations, comparative statements, POs, contracts and commercial agreements.
Ensure vendor documentation and statutory requirements are properly maintained.
Coordinate with Finance and Accounts regarding invoices, payment terms and vendor reconciliation.
Support internal and external audits related to procurement.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Commerce, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain, Procurement or Operations will be an added advantage.
Technical qualification in Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC or Cold Chain will be preferred.
roles.experience: 10–15 years of experience in Purchase / Procurement, with significant experience in a managerial or leadership role. Mandatory experience in Cold Room, Cold Storage, Refrigeration, HVAC, or related project procurement. Experience with Cold Room manufacturers, Refrigeration companies, HVAC contractors, Cold Storage project companies, or Engineering Project companies will be strongly preferred. Should have an established vendor network for refrigeration equipment, PUF/PIR panels, cold room doors, electrical components, insulation materials, piping, hardware and project materials. Experience managing a purchase team and handling large-scale project procurement will be preferred.
skills: Strong experience in Purchase / Procurement Management.
Mandatory knowledge of Cold Room / Cold Storage / Refrigeration / HVAC project procurement.
Strong understanding of BOQ, technical specifications, drawings and project material requirements.
Excellent vendor development and supplier management skills.
Strong commercial negotiation and cost-control abilities.
Good knowledge of market pricing and technical materials.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Strong analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP / Procurement Management Systems.
Ability to manage multiple projects and procurement requirements simultaneously.

roles.title: Sales Coordinator
roles.company_overview: Crystal Logistics is India's trusted cold chain and warehousing partner, delivering reliable temperature-controlled logistics solutions across the country. With over 60 years of industry excellence, we specialize in cold storage, reefer transportation, portable cold storage containers, and end-to-end supply chain solutions. We foster a collaborative, performance-driven, and growth-oriented work culture where employees are empowered to learn, innovate, and build rewarding careers.
roles.role_summary:
We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Sales Coordinator (Telecaller / Tele-Sales) to support our sales team by generating business opportunities, handling customer inquiries, and coordinating with internal teams for seamless service delivery.
The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a persuasive approach, and a customer-centric mindset. Success in this role will be measured by lead generation, customer satisfaction, CRM accuracy, and contribution to achieving the company's sales targets.
responsibilities: Make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers to promote Crystal Logistics' cold chain and logistics services.
Generate, qualify, and nurture sales leads for the field sales and business development team.
Handle inbound customer inquiries and provide accurate information regarding company services and pricing.
Follow up with potential customers to maximize conversion opportunities.
Process customer orders and coordinate with the operations team for smooth execution.
Maintain accurate customer records, call logs, and sales activities in the CRM system.
Build long-term customer relationships through timely communication and regular follow-ups.
Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Customer Support teams to ensure excellent customer experience.
Prepare daily and weekly reports on calls, leads, customer feedback, and sales activities.
Support the sales team in achieving monthly business targets and revenue goals.
qualifications: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelor's Degree preferred).
Certification in Sales, Customer Service, or CRM tools will be an added advantage.
roles.experience: 1–3 years of experience in Telecalling, Tele-Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Support, or Sales Coordination. Experience in Cold Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, Transportation, Warehousing, or any B2B service industry will be preferred. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong sales aptitude may also be considered.
skills: Knowledge of CRM software (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or similar platforms)
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and email communication
Basic understanding of logistics and supply chain operations
Ability to manage customer databases and sales reports
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Salary Range: ₹2.40 LPA – ₹3.60 LPA (Based on experience and interview performance)
Paid Leave and Statutory Benefits as per company policy

roles.role_summary: The Purchase Executive will be responsible for managing procurement activities for Cold Room Projects by sourcing quality materials, developing vendor relationships, negotiating competitive prices, and ensuring timely availability of materials for project execution. The role requires close coordination with Project, Engineering, Stores, and Finance teams to support seamless project delivery.
responsibilities: Procurement Management:
Procure materials, equipment, and services required for Cold Room and Cold Storage Projects.
Review project BOQs, drawings, and material specifications before procurement.
Raise Purchase Orders (POs), obtain approvals, and monitor order execution.
Ensure timely procurement to meet project schedules and deadlines.
Monitor material availability and coordinate replenishment whenever required.
Technical Material Procurement:
Procure refrigeration and cold room components.
Verify material specifications and ensure procurement complies with approved technical requirements.
Vendor Management
Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable vendors for Cold Room and Refrigeration materials.
Obtain quotations, compare prices, and prepare comparative statements.
Build long-term relationships with suppliers to ensure quality, competitive pricing, and timely deliveries.
Resolve supplier-related issues regarding quality, quantity, and delivery.
Cost Control & Negotiation
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and commercial conditions.
Conduct market research to identify cost-saving opportunities.
Ensure procurement is completed within approved budgets without compromising quality.
Project Coordination
Coordinate with Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Stores, and Operations teams regarding material requirements.

Documentation & Compliance
Maintain purchase orders, quotations, vendor records, invoices, and procurement documentation.
Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies and approval processes.
Update procurement records in ERP or inventory management systems.
Support internal audits by maintaining complete procurement documentation.

Candidates from Cold Room Manufacturers, Refrigeration Companies, HVAC Contractors, Cold Storage Project Companies, or Industrial Refrigeration Industries will be preferred. skills: Strong knowledge of Cold Room Projects and Refrigeration Systems.
Hands-on experience in procuring cold room materials and refrigeration components.
Understanding of project BOQs, technical drawings, and material specifications.
Excellent vendor development and supplier management skills.
Strong negotiation and cost analysis abilities.
Good knowledge of procurement processes and documentation.
Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple procurement activities simultaneously.

roles.title: Inventory In-Charge
roles.company_overview: Established in 1962, Crystal Cold Chain has over 60 years of experience in delivering reliable temperature-controlled storage and logistics solutions across India. We specialize in Portable Cold Storage Containers, Cold Storage Warehouses, and temperature-controlled transportation services, ensuring safe and efficient handling of temperature-sensitive goods. Our solutions support a wide range of industries, including FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Agriculture, Meat & Seafood, Chemicals, Quick Commerce, and other temperature-sensitive sectors. With a strong legacy of trust and operational excellence, Crystal Cold Chain continues to provide flexible and dependable cold chain solutions tailored to modern industry needs.
roles.role_summary: The Inventory In-Charge will be responsible for managing the complete inventory and store function, including receiving, inspection, storage, issuance, stock monitoring, reconciliation, and inventory reporting. The candidate should have strong knowledge of inventory management and preferably experience handling cold room, refrigeration, engineering, spare parts, or project-related materials.
responsibilities: 1. Inventory & Stock Management:
Manage day-to-day inventory and store activities.
Receive, verify, count, and record incoming materials.
Maintain accurate stock records for all materials, spare parts, tools, equipment, and consumables.
Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of required materials.
Ensure proper identification, tagging, labelling, and storage of materials.
Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels as required.
2. Material Receiving & Issuance:
Check received materials against Purchase Orders, invoices, delivery challans, and required specifications.
Coordinate with Purchase and Project teams regarding material discrepancies or shortages.
Issue materials to project, site, operations, and other departments against approved material requests.
Maintain proper records of all inward and outward material movements.
Ensure materials are issued according to approved requirements and authorization.
3. Cold Room / Refrigeration Material Management:
Manage inventory of cold room and refrigeration project materials, spare parts, tools, and accessories.
Maintain proper stock records for items such as PUF/PIR panels, cold room doors, refrigeration components, copper pipes, electrical items, controllers, sensors, fittings, hardware, and consumables.
Understand basic material specifications and identify materials correctly.
Ensure proper storage and handling of technical and project materials.
4. Stock Reconciliation & Physical Verification:
Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them with system records.
Identify stock discrepancies, shortages, excess stock, damaged materials, and obsolete inventory.
Investigate inventory variances and coordinate with concerned departments for corrective action.
Maintain high inventory accuracy and ensure proper documentation of adjustments.
5. Inventory Documentation & MIS:
Maintain GRN, stock registers, material issue slips, transfer records, and other inventory documents.
Update inventory transactions in ERP / Inventory Management Systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
Maintain records of slow-moving, non-moving, damaged, and obsolete inventory.
Provide inventory data and reports to management as required.
6. Store Management & Material Handling:
Ensure proper arrangement and systematic storage of materials.
Maintain cleanliness, safety, and discipline within the store area.
Follow proper material handling and storage procedures.
Ensure materials are protected from damage, moisture, loss, or deterioration.
Coordinate with housekeeping, security, and other teams for smooth store operations.
7. Coordination with Internal Teams:
Coordinate with Purchase, Projects, Engineering, Operations, Accounts, and Site Teams regarding material requirements.
Inform the Purchase team about low-stock and replenishment requirements.
Coordinate with Project and Site teams for material dispatch and availability.
Support Accounts and Purchase teams with material-related documentation.
Ensure timely availability of materials for project and operational requirements.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, Operations, or a related field.
Certification in Inventory Management / Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage.
roles.experience: 3–6 years of experience in Inventory / Stores / Warehouse Management. Experience in Cold Room, Cold Storage, Refrigeration, HVAC, Engineering Projects, Logistics, or Industrial Equipment will be preferred. Candidates who have handled technical materials, refrigeration spare parts, project materials, and engineering inventory will be preferred. Practical experience with ERP-based inventory management and stock reconciliation is essential.
skills: Strong knowledge of Inventory and Store Management.
Experience in material receiving, issuance, stock control, and reconciliation.
Good understanding of cold room, refrigeration, engineering, spare parts, or project materials will be preferred.
Knowledge of GRN, Purchase Orders, stock registers, material issue notes, and inventory documentation.
Strong MS Excel skills and experience with ERP / inventory management software.
Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up abilities.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple inventory activities and meet deadlines.
Strong understanding of stock control and warehouse safety practices.

Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Customer Success, and Service teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

roles.title: Cold Room Site Engineer
roles.company_overview: Established in 1962, Crystal Cold Chain has over 60 years of experience in delivering reliable temperature-controlled storage and logistics solutions across India. We specialize in Portable Cold Storage Containers, Cold Storage Warehouses, and temperature-controlled transportation services, ensuring safe and efficient handling of temperature-sensitive goods. Our solutions support a wide range of industries, including FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Agriculture, Meat & Seafood, Chemicals, Quick Commerce, and other temperature-sensitive sectors. With a strong legacy of trust and operational excellence, Crystal Cold Chain continues to provide flexible and dependable cold chain solutions tailored to modern industry needs.
roles.role_summary: This is a ground-up role. You will be on-site, not in an office. When a cold room order comes in, you own everything that happens from that moment until the unit is commissioned, tested, handed over to the client, and signed off. You coordinate the civil contractors, the electrical team, the refrigeration vendors, and the equipment delivery, and you are the face of Crystal to the client on the ground. You report back daily to project management so leadership always knows exactly where each site stands. If you are someone who likes to see what they have built at the end of the day, this role is for you.
responsibilities: Review order, drawings, BOQ, and site layout before mobilisation.
Coordinate civil works (foundation, flooring, drainage, structure) ensuring quality and timelines.
Manage electrical works including power supply, wiring, DB, and earthing checks.
Coordinate equipment delivery and installation with refrigeration vendors.
Supervise insulation panel installation ensuring proper joints and sealing.
Act as on-site POC, providing updates and resolving client queries.
Conduct daily site inspections for quality, materials, and safety compliance.
Prepare and share daily and weekly site progress reports.
Identify and close snag items before final client walkthrough.
Complete commissioning documents and final handover records.
Train client teams on basic operations and troubleshooting.
Coordinate material and spare requirements with procurement.
qualifications: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or Electrical Engineering
2-6 years of on-site experience in cold room installation, commissioning, or HVAC projects
roles.experience: 2-6 years of on-site experience in cold room installation, commissioning, or HVAC projects Hands-on knowledge of refrigeration equipment and insulated panels. Ability to manage civil and electrical contractors on site. Proficient in reading AutoCAD drawings, BOQs, and schematics. Willing to travel and stay on project sites across India.
